questions.stem: What can happen when the cell cycle is no longer properly controlled?

options.text: The cell undergoes differentiation into a specialised cell
The cell becomes a stem cell
Uncontrolled cell division occurs, which can lead to cancer

questions.explanation: When the checkpoints that control the cell cycle fail, cells can divide uncontrollably, forming a mass of abnormal cells called a tumour. This unregulated growth is the basis of cancer.
